status_rule: Scripts refuse to preprocess, train, infer or analyse A2 data until status is 'locked_before_a2_training' and this file is committed and pushed. When locking, change only the status field.

parent_protocol.unchanged: H1-H3, the parent analysis report and the A1 report are not changed, re-tested or re-interpreted

purpose.A_normalisation_scope: Test whether the E6 deficit reflects z-scoring itself or its full-record scope (about 23 h, mostly daytime, in Sleep-EDF versus the night in SHHS1), by retraining E6 with a label-free normalisation whose scope is the same in both cohorts.
purpose.B_training_seeds: Characterise between-seed variability of the recommended band-pass pipeline (E4) with five training seeds instead of two, and compare it with the configuration contrasts.
purpose.C_ensemble_asymmetry: Quantify how much the ten-model ensemble used on SHHS1 changes scores relative to single fold models, the unit used on Sleep-EDF.
purpose.D_em_sample_size: Test whether the collapse of EM prior correction is due to estimating the prior from five recordings or to the label-shift assumption failing, by repeating the original procedure with only the prior-estimation data changed.
purpose.E_training_cost: Decompose the training-time difference between E0 and the ResNet-1D-TCN pipelines into optimiser steps, time per step and the remainder.
purpose.text_only: The ADAST backbone difference and the absence of a shared EEG derivation are handled in the manuscript text; no experiment is added for them.

status_of_holdout: Holdout labels were used by the parent analysis and by A1. A2 is post-confirmatory and descriptive. No arm, seed, window length, subset size, draw count or interpretation rule below depends on A2 results; all are fixed before any A2 preprocessing, training, inference or analysis.

training.source: Sleep-EDF SC, the locked ten-fold subject split data/splits/sleepedf_sc_10fold_seed42_v2.json, validation fold = next fold
training.runner: the current scripts/run_experiment.py code path (src/sleeptcn/experiment.run_experiment) with the unchanged configs/experiments_v2.json; this runner was refactored after the seed-123 campaign (commit 88a5d2c), so its equivalence is checked first
training.split_compatibility: the frozen split file is not edited (runs record its hash); src/sleeptcn/dataset.POST_SPLIT_VARIANTS admits the A2 variant, and the A2 preprocessing check requires every new Sleep-EDF record to have the same record key, labels and original epoch indices as its filtered_v2 counterpart

reproduction_check.run: E4, fold 0, seed 123, trained with the A2 runner on the rented GPU before any A2 run, under runs/a2/full/REPRO_E4/fold_00/seed_123
reproduction_check.reference: archived seed-123 E4 fold-0 run at commit 8af1d12 (completed epochs, best epoch and best validation macro-F1 of each stage; validation predictions)
reproduction_check.outcome: reported as identical or, if not, the size of the difference in validation macro-F1, best epoch and predicted-label agreement; A2 proceeds either way and the result is disclosed, because GPU and library versions differ from the original campaign

E6R.normalisation: band-pass 0.5-30 Hz, clip +-800 uV, centred moving-window z-score over 90 min (window truncated at record edges), standard-deviation floor 1 uV; statistics from the filtered, clipped signal only, no labels
E6R.rationale: the statistics come from the same 90-min local scope in both cohorts, so the input scale no longer depends on recording length; 90 min is about one sleep cycle

training.seed_note: 2025 is listed in configs/experiments_v2.json as the third confirmatory training seed but was never trained; 2027 and 2029 are fixed here. With the archived seeds 42 and 123 this gives five E4 seeds. E6R uses the two seeds of the archived E6 runs so that E6R and E6 are compared seed by seed.
training.parallelism: several training processes may share one GPU; each run is independent and deterministic settings are unchanged
training.sleep_edf_test: after every A2 run has completed validation-only training and passed run validation, the locked Sleep-EDF test folds are evaluated once with the pre-locked best checkpoints (out-of-fold predictions)

shhs.cohort: the 500 holdout participants of the parent analysis
shhs.new_variant_preprocessing: same EDF/XML inputs, channel, resampling, label mapping and evaluation window as the parent manifest; written to a separate A2 manifest under data/processed/shhs_holdout_a2
shhs.existing_variants: E4 arms reuse the hash-verified bandpass_v2 holdout inputs of the parent manifest
shhs.ensembling: arithmetic mean of the ten fold softmax probabilities (float64 accumulator, float32 storage), argmax; every fold artifact is kept
shhs.device: CPU or CUDA; on the device used, the A2 inference code must first reproduce the stored parent CPU fold probabilities of E4_s42 for two records at folds 0 and 9 within 1e-5 with identical argmax, and holdout inference starts only after the A2 Sleep-EDF test campaign is complete
shhs.first_sample: not used by A2 except that analysis D reuses the archived EM fits estimated on the five first-sample adaptation recordings

analyses.hypothesis_tests: none; all A2 results are descriptive

A_normalisation_scope.input_scale: median and IQR of the within-evaluation-window standard deviation of the E6 and E6R inputs on Sleep-EDF and on the holdout sample
A_normalisation_scope.sleep_edf: pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 of E6R against E3, E4 and E6 at the same seed
A_normalisation_scope.interpretation_rule: The manuscript keeps the statement that preserving calibrated amplitude transferred better than z-scoring only if E4 - E6R has a bootstrap interval above zero at both seeds. Otherwise the statement is restricted to full-record z-scoring as implemented, and the E6R result is reported as showing that the E6 deficit depended on the normalisation scope.

B_training_seeds.metrics: holdout subject-mean macro-F1 and Sleep-EDF pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 per seed; mean, sample standard deviation and range over the five seeds; all ten pairwise between-seed differences of holdout subject-mean macro-F1 with paired bootstrap intervals
B_training_seeds.configuration_contrast: E4 at each of the five seeds minus E0 at seeds 42 and 123 (ten pairs), and E4 at each seed minus E2 at seeds 42 and 123, in holdout subject-mean macro-F1 with paired bootstrap intervals; reported against the range of the ten between-seed differences
B_training_seeds.interpretation_rule: The manuscript replaces the two-seed range of between-seed differences with the five-seed summary. The pipeline contrasts are described as exceeding training variability only if every E4 - E0 and E4 - E2 pair exceeds the largest absolute between-seed difference of E4; no new test is made.

C_ensemble_asymmetry.arms: all parent zero-shot holdout arms (E0, E2, E3, E4, E6 at seeds 42 and 123) and all A2 arms
C_ensemble_asymmetry.metrics: for each fold model alone on the holdout sample: subject-mean macro-F1, pooled macro-F1, N3 recall, N3->N2 rate; mean and range over the ten fold models; ensemble minus mean single-model subject-mean macro-F1 with a paired bootstrap interval
C_ensemble_asymmetry.cross_cohort_drop: for E3 and E4 at seeds 42 and 123, the Sleep-EDF pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 minus the mean single-model pooled macro-F1 on the holdout sample, reported beside the drop computed with the ensemble

D_em_sample_size.models: the ten seed-123 E3 fold models used in the original calibration experiment
D_em_sample_size.procedure: exactly the original one: per fold, holdout fold probabilities are temperature-scaled with the archived fold temperature (runs/teacher_revision_cpu_20261003/calibration_10fold_seed123/fits), the target prior is estimated by estimate_target_prior in src/sleeptcn/calibration.py (initialised at and relative to the archived fold source prior; tolerance 1e-8, at most 1000 iterations, floor 1e-12), each fold's calibrated probabilities are adjusted by adjust_prior, and the ten adjusted folds are averaged before argmax. Only the data used to estimate the target prior changes.
D_em_sample_size.holdout_probabilities: stored per-fold holdout probabilities of arm E3_s123 (runs/holdout_inference_v1/fold_predictions/E3_s123), evaluation-window epochs

prior_data.original_five: the archived fold target priors estimated on the five unlabelled first-sample adaptation recordings, applied unchanged
prior_data.random_subsets: unlabelled epochs of n holdout recordings drawn without replacement, n in [5, 20, 100], 200 draws each, numpy default_rng(2044)
prior_data.adabn_sample: the 20,000 unlabelled epochs of the A1 AdaBN sample (40 per holdout recording; runs/holdout_amendment_a1 adabn_sample.npz, matched by record key and original epoch index)
prior_data.all: unlabelled epochs of all 500 holdout recordings
prior_data.per_record: each recording's own unlabelled epochs, applied to that recording only

D_em_sample_size.outcomes: fold-mean estimated N3 prior against the observed holdout N3 share; after adjustment of all 500 recordings: share of epochs predicted N3, pooled N3 recall, pooled macro-F1 and subject-mean macro-F1; for random subsets the median and 2.5th-97.5th percentiles over draws
D_em_sample_size.interpretation_rule: If the priors estimated from the AdaBN sample and from all 500 recordings still lie far below the observed N3 share (less than half of it) and reduce N3 recall below that of the temperature-scaled ensemble without prior adjustment, the collapse is attributed to the label-shift assumption failing under feature shift, not to the five-recording sample. If they approach the observed share and do not reduce N3 recall, the collapse is attributed to the small adaptation sample.

E_training_cost.steps: completed epochs, validation events and optimiser steps (progress.global_steps) of every training stage of every fold of the archived seed-123 campaign for E0, E2, E3, E4 and E6, read from the latest.pt checkpoints at commit 8af1d12
E_training_cost.step_time: time per optimiser step through the training code path (engine.run_loader with the recipe's optimiser, loss and gradient clipping) for one baseline CNN branch (batch 64 epochs), ResNet-1D (batch 64 epochs), BiLSTM (batches of 4 recordings) and TCN (batches of 8 recordings) with synthetic values; sequence batches use the real fold-0 training record lengths grouped in shuffled order (generator seed 2045), so padding matches training; pre-built batches exclude data loading; per model 20 warm-up steps, then three rounds of 200 timed steps through one run_loader call each (as in a training epoch), run alone on the rented GPU; the mean time per step of each round and the range over rounds are reported, and totals use the mean over rounds
E_training_cost.outcome: per configuration: total optimiser steps, steps x mean step time, and the remainder of the observed wall-clock time (validation passes, data loading, checkpointing); because the rented GPU may differ from the original V100, configurations are compared by ratios
E_training_cost.interpretation_rule: The manuscript states how much of the E0/E3 training-time ratio is due to the number of optimiser steps and how much to the time per step, and no longer presents the ratio as an architectural property.
